p: Color scheme for the text editor
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 30, 30, 30): Gets or sets the background color of the editor
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 40, 40, 40): Gets or sets the background color of the line number area
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 128, 128, 128): Gets or sets the text color of line numbers
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 255, 255, 255): Gets or sets the default text color
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(50, 255, 255, 255): Gets or sets the highlight color for the current line
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 60, 60, 60): Gets or sets the color of the scrollbar background
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 100, 100, 100): Gets or sets the color of the scrollbar thumb
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(100, 0, 120, 215): Gets or sets the color of selected text
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 255, 255, 255): Gets or sets the color of the text cursor
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 86, 156, 214): Gets or sets the color for syntax highlighting keywords
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 206, 145, 120): Gets or sets the color for syntax highlighting strings
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 106, 153, 85): Gets or sets the color for syntax highlighting comments
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 181, 206, 168): Gets or sets the color for syntax highlighting numbers
